children: Interiors made for the way you live
Atelier Nord is a full-service residential design studio — considered rooms, careful renovations and pieces sourced with intention. Book a consultation to begin.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: From the first sketch to the final cushion, we design, manage and install — so you live with the result, not the logistics.
We open doors you can’t: to-the-trade fabrics, furniture and finishes, specified and priced with our accounts working in your favour.
We hold the trades, the timeline and the budget together, so a renovation runs on schedule and the surprises stay small.
No house style stamped onto your home. We design around how you actually use each room, and who you share it with.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Atelier Nord is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A calm, light-filled interior with layered textures and natural materials

children: Atelier Nord began with a simple belief: a home should be designed around the people who live in it, not a trend or a template. We work with a small number of residential clients at a time, so every project gets the attention it deserves.
From single rooms to whole-home renovations, we bring the same care — honest advice, considered design, and a calm hand on every detail from concept to install.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: We take on a handful of projects at once. That’s deliberate: it’s how each room gets the thought, sourcing and management it needs.
We plan to your budget from the first meeting and keep it visible throughout — no creeping numbers, no awkward surprises at the end.
The best compliment we get is that a home looks like the people in it. We design to your life, then step back so it’s entirely yours.
